name: Anwar Info Service Box for Elementor
author: anwarhossanrony

sections.description:
Anwar Info Service Box for Elementor adds a professional Info/Service Box widget to Elementor.

Useful for:
– Service sections
– Feature cards
– Legal, agency, business, and portfolio service blocks
– Call to action cards
– Modern icon boxes

Features:
– Elementor widget for info and service boxes
– Five predefined card styles
– Icon, category, badge, title, description, button, and ping icon controls
– Full box link or button-only link behavior
– Ping size, color, shadow color, shadow size, animation speed, and spacing controls
– Button position controls for left, center, and right alignment
– Content text alignment controls for left, center, and right alignment
– Typography, color, border, radius, shadow, padding, and spacing controls
– Responsive defaults for desktop, tablet, and mobile devices
– Lightweight frontend CSS only
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/anwar-info-service-box-for-elementor directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Make sure Elementor is installed and activated.
  4. Open Elementor and search for “Info/Service Box”.
sections.faq:
Does it work with Elementor Free?

Yes.

Can I make the whole box clickable?

Yes. Use the Link Behavior option and choose Full Box Link.

Can I customize the ping icon?

Yes. You can change the ping size, color, shadow color, shadow size, animation speed, and spacing.

Is it mobile friendly?

Yes. The widget includes responsive defaults and responsive Elementor controls.

Can I change typography and spacing?

Yes. The widget includes typography controls and spacing controls for the main card elements.

short_description: Create responsive info, feature, and service box cards in Elementor with five predefined styles and flexible design controls.
